name: Product card
description: A flexible card for the products your customers love.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1,
  id: "acme/product-card-pro",
  name: "Pro product card",
  kind: Kind.productCard,
  description: "Product tile with image, price, discount badge and add button.",
  aiHints: "Use for product tiles. Variants: vertical (image on top), horizontal (image on the left). Options for corner radius, image shape, calories and button text.",
  options: [
    EnumOption(name: "radius", label: "Corner radius",
      values: [Radius.none, Radius.sm, Radius.md, Radius.lg], default: Radius.md),
    EnumOption(name: "imageRatio", label: "Image shape",
      values: ["1:1", "4:3", "16:9"], default: "4:3"),
    BoolOption(name: "showCalories", label: "Show calories", default: false),
    StringOption(name: "ctaLabel", label: "Button text", maxLength: 24, default: "Add"),
  DataOption(name: "product", type: Product, required: true)],
  parts: [
    Part(
      name: "priceRow",
      build: Row(
        gap: Space.sm,
        align: Align.center,
        children: [
          Text(child: formatMoney(options.product.display_price_cents),
               weight: FontWeight.bold, size: FontSize.lg),
          If(
            condition: discountPercent(options.product.display_price_cents, options.product.compare_at_price_cents) > 0,
            then: Text(child: formatMoney(options.product.compare_at_price_cents),
                       strike: true, color: Color.textMuted, size: FontSize.sm),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ),
    Part(
      name: "addButton",
      build: Button(
        label: options.ctaLabel,
        style: ButtonStyle.primary,
        size: Size.sm,
        fullWidth: true,
        disabled: !options.product.is_available,
        onTap: AddToCart(product: options.product),
      ),
    ),
  ],
  variants: [
    Variant(
      id: "vertical",
      label: "Vertical",
      build: Box(
        radius: options.radius,
        background: Color.surface,
        border: Border(width: 1, color: Color.border),
        shadow: Shadow.sm,
        clip: true,
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Layers(
              child: Box(
                onTap: OpenProduct(product: options.product),
                ariaLabel: options.product.name,
                child: Image(
                  src: options.product.image_url,
                  alt: options.product.name,
                  aspectRatio: ratio(options.imageRatio),
                  fit: Fit.cover,
                ),
              ),
              layers: [
                Layer(
                  anchor: Anchor.topLeft,
                  inset: Space.sm,
                  child: If(
                    condition: discountPercent(options.product.display_price_cents, options.product.compare_at_price_cents) > 0,
                    then: Badge(
                      label: "-${discountPercent(options.product.display_price_cents, options.product.compare_at_price_cents)}%",
                      tone: Tone.danger,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            Column(
              gap: Space.sm,
              padding: Space.md,
              children: [
                Text(child: options.product.name, role: TextRole.heading, level: 3,
                     weight: FontWeight.semibold, maxLines: 2),
                Text(child: truncate(options.product.description, 80),
                     color: Color.textMuted, size: FontSize.sm, maxLines: 2),
                If(
                  condition: options.showCalories && options.product.calories != null,
                  then: Text(child: "${options.product.calories} kcal", size: FontSize.xs, color: Color.textMuted),
                ),
                Use(part: "priceRow"),
                Use(part: "addButton"),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
    Variant(
      id: "horizontal",
      label: "Horizontal",
      build: Box(
        radius: options.radius,
        background: Color.surface,
        border: Border(width: 1, color: Color.border),
        clip: true,
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Box(
              width: 120,
              onTap: OpenProduct(product: options.product),
              ariaLabel: options.product.name,
              child: Image(src: options.product.image_url, alt: options.product.name, fit: Fit.cover, aspectRatio: 1),
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                gap: Space.xs,
                padding: Space.md,
                children: [
                  Text(child: options.product.name, role: TextRole.heading, level: 3, weight: FontWeight.semibold),
                  Use(part: "priceRow"),
                  Use(part: "addButton"),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  ],
)
